items.title: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
items.summary: Ahead of elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could turn to blockchain and crypto to skirt potential international sanctions, to the dismay of opponents and the country’s central banker.

items.title: Dogecoin Foundation and House of Doge End Exclusive Brand Deal
items.summary: House of Doge keeps limited investment-product rights, while a separate deal would exchange Such App assets for $4 million in Dogecoin Labs stock.

items.title: Crypto longs lose $404 million in four hours as bitcoin briefly slips below $80,000
items.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs lost $773 million on Thursday and Friday after three days of net inflows, per SoSoValue data.
